The Expert Program is for people who build coworkers for other people: agencies, freelancers, consultants and operators. It runs on Rerun Cloud.

## Joining

Applications are reviewed by hand by the Rerun team, who reply by email with the next step. What helps: coworkers you have actually shipped, a clear specialty, and a profile that a client can act on.

Once accepted, you claim your account and your sandbox from the link you receive. Before the sandbox opens, you accept the program conditions:

- the Rerun Creator Terms and the Marketplace Terms
- publishing at least one template per month
- submitting only templates that are tested and work end to end
- using the sandbox to build and capture templates, not for client work

## The sandbox

Open it from the workspace menu: **Expert** > **Sandbox**. It is where [templates are captured from](/templates/create): capturing is restricted to the sandbox on purpose, so a client workspace can never be published by accident. The **Templates** menu, with **My templates** and **New template**, only shows while you are in it.

A sandbox runs on a machine of its own, with no coworker limit and no bill, but it is not a full workspace:

- it has a single Box
- it has no settings, members or billing of its own
- it keeps its AI providers, its [Brain](/brain) and the API key the [template tools](/api/tools/templates) need
- it cannot buy paid templates: switch to a workspace for that
- coworker notifications stay in the app and are never emailed, so a test cron failing overnight stays out of your inbox

### When a sandbox sits unused

A sandbox keeps a machine running, so one that is not opened for 30 days is archived to free it. An email warns you before the date, and opening the sandbox before then changes nothing.

Once archived, its coworkers, their memory and their files are saved until the date shown on the board, then deleted for good. To get it back, click **Request reactivation** on the board and say in a sentence or two what you plan to build. The Rerun team reviews every request; once approved, the restore takes a couple of minutes and the sandbox comes back exactly as you left it. If its saved data has already expired, a reactivation starts from an empty sandbox.

## Your profile

Edit it from the workspace menu: **Expert** > **Public profile**, then **Save & publish**. The directory profile carries your name and location, your bio, your availability and budget range, your skills, the languages you work in, and your links. Clients filter on all of it.

The bio is the part clients actually read, so lead with what you have shipped rather than what you offer.

## Selling templates

Publishing rights come with the program. See [Create a template](/templates/create) for the workflow and [Sell a template](/templates/selling) for pricing and payouts.
